entries.clue: Deck on iron legs striding out from the promenade, amusements at the end
Metered ride hailed at the kerb, or what a plane does trundling on the ground
Stream of vehicles on the ring road, or a shady trade in contraband
Tall glass sweet-shop vessel, lifted down and tipped over the counter
Bertie Bassett's jumble of layered black-and-pink sandwiches and coconut wheels
Far north named for the Bear overhead, where the pole sits on drifting ice
Dog-driving Norwegian who reached 90 degrees south five weeks ahead
Typewriter part that slides back with a ding, or one unit of a train
Hidden split in a glacier, bridged over by treacherous drifted snow
Black root flavouring drawn into long laces and Pontefract cakes
Drifting slab of frozen sea a beset ship may be pinned among
Brass pans and little weights, balanced out to a quarter of pear drops
Anyone aboard who is not crewing, or a team member not pulling their weight
